assumptions.aggregation: File totals include duplicate captures. Waterfall sums per-tape allocations; it does not re-round aggregate PnL.
assumptions.execution: Strategy D SELL flow at or below our limit consumes queue before filling at the resting bid. BUY flow never fills a maker bid.
assumptions.lookahead: Selection and expiry use full-capture metadata. Quotes use only the initial print; spread, depth, model, and settlement remain assumptions.
assumptions.pricing: Initial token print seeds a clipped 1..97-cent bid; ask is bid+2, resting maker limit is bid+1, with five assumed lots ahead.
assumptions.selection: Primary contract by normalized trade count; ID breaks ties.
assumptions.settlement: Assumed winning payout; not an official venue resolution.
assumptions.time_bounds: First token timestamp seeds the book. Decision is 1ns later; all prints at that first timestamp are excluded from execution. Expiry is 300s after the last selected token print.

data_qualification.scope: Offline replay of existing captures; neither a new harvest nor venue profit certification.

results.lookahead_disclosure: Contract selection and expiry bounds use full-capture metadata. The first timestamp seeds the quote and is excluded from execution; later prices do not change it.
